prompt: How should the host explain what Marta meant by ‘the chalk could do the waiting’?
promptZh: 主持人應如何解釋瑪塔說的「讓粉筆替他等」？

options.text: Her brother could step away to buy eggs without losing his turn at the parcel counter.
options.zh: 她哥哥可以先去買蛋，而不會失去在包裹櫃臺原本的排隊順位。
options.whyZh: 助手依到達順序寫下姓名，叫到之前順位不變。哥哥離開去買蛋，叫到名字時再回來；黑板保留的是原本的順位，不是加快備貨或讓人插隊。

options.text: Her brother could buy eggs first and then move ahead of people already waiting for parcels.
options.zh: 她哥哥可以先買蛋，回來後再排到原本就在等包裹的人前面。
options.whyZh: 離開片刻不會失去原有順位，也不會因此排到先來的人前面。

options.text: Her brother’s name told the helper to get the parcel ready sooner so he could go and buy eggs.
options.zh: 寫上她哥哥的名字，是要請助手加快準備包裹，讓他可以去買蛋。
options.whyZh: 寫上名字不代表包裹已備妥，也沒有指示助手加快準備。

options.text: Her brother could have the eggs recorded as part of the parcel instead of waiting to collect it.
options.zh: 她哥哥可以把蛋登記為包裹的一部分，不必等著領取包裹。
options.whyZh: 黑板不是購物清單；買蛋和回來領包裹是兩件事。

explanationZh: 助手依到達順序寫下姓名，叫到之前順位不變。哥哥離開去買蛋，叫到名字時再回來；黑板保留的是原本的順位，不是加快備貨或讓人插隊。
evidence: in the order people reached the counter / Each name stayed in that sequence until it was called. / It was not a list of purchases, and writing a name did not mean a parcel was ready. / I told him the chalk could do the waiting for him. / They came back together when the helper called his name.

vocabulary.note: jump the queue 指搶到先到的人前面，不只是暫時離開隊伍。
